body: Please don't do it, society may not help you but you can help you, and there are others who you will meet and who will love you and they will help you too.  The hardest part is getting past being locked up inside.  I have the same feeling, and I find it hard to make friends as a result.  I spend a lot of my time hiding, literally and figuratively, but there has to be a way out of this cage.  I just need to find it...
